# Somya Ranjan Sahoo

> Portfolio of Somya Ranjan Sahoo (Sonu), an aspiring data analyst and software developer from Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. He is a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student at GITA Autonomous College, working with Python, SQL and Excel, and is open to internships and hackathon teams.

The whole portfolio is one page, https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/, and the links below go to its sections.

## Portfolio

- [Data lab](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/#data): Analysis of a registry of 2,003 Indian toll plazas, an Excel dashboard and a live SQL database that visitors can query.
- [Projects](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/#work): Case studies of the projects listed below, with screenshots and results.
- [About](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/#about): Background, including seven years at Sainik School Bhubaneswar, NCC training and the ASTRA-X hackathon team.
- [Experience](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/#experience): Back-End / Python Developer Intern at The Entrepreneurship Network, May to August 2026.
- [Credentials](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/#credentials): Certificates and awards, including Best Innovation Team at CHAKRAVYUH 1.0 and national hackathon finalist at India Innovates 2026.
- [Resume](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/#resume): One-page resume to read or download.
- [Contact](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/#contact): Contact form and links.

## Projects

- [India Toll Network Analysis](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/projects/india-toll-network-analysis/): Data analysis of India's toll plazas: where they are, who runs them and whether the data can be trusted. Code: https://github.com/somyaranjansahoo6422/india-toll-network-analysis
- [Smart Toll Plaza Management and GIS Command Center](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/projects/smart-toll-plaza/): A toll operations prototype with live number-plate recognition and a Pan-India plaza map. Code: https://github.com/somyaranjansahoo6422/smart-toll-plaza-system
- [VANTAGE: ZERO](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/projects/vantage-zero/): A voice-controlled 3D combat flight game that runs in the browser. Code: https://github.com/somyaranjansahoo6422/Game-using-Wispr-Flow
- [GOD VIEW](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/projects/god-view/): An open-source-intelligence digital twin with live flights and satellites on a 3D globe, linked in a knowledge graph. Code: https://github.com/somyaranjansahoo6422/GOD-VIEW
- [UNSPOKEN](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/projects/unspoken/): A chest-mounted wearable that helps visually impaired users sense obstacles and lets non-verbal users speak through gestures. Code: https://github.com/somyaranjansahoo6422/unspoken
- [ANUMATI](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/projects/anumati/): A regulatory-clearance engine that models business licences as a dependency graph. Team project, Smart India Hackathon 2026 college round.
- [Student Attendance Management System](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/projects/student-attendance-system/): A multi-role desktop app where students check in by scanning a QR code. Code: https://github.com/somyaranjansahoo6422/Student_Attendance_Management_System
- [VECTOR](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/projects/vector/): An air-traffic-control simulator you play with spoken ATC commands, built by voice dictation.
- [Face-scan Verification & Fraud Console](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/projects/face-scan-fraud-console/): Two team builds from Hacker House Goa 2026: face-scan verification anchored on Solana, and a card-fraud console over TigerGraph. Code: https://github.com/Swagat-CREATOR/hhgoa-task-3-by-ASTRA-X-
- [MindEase](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/projects/mindease/): A 10-question stress self-check for college students, shortlisted at Smart India Hackathon 2025.
- [Smaller builds](https://somyaranjansahoo6422.github.io/projects/smaller-builds/): Python games and utilities, including Snake, Pong, Connect 4 vs AI, a calculator and an expense tracker, with demo videos.
